_about: The eight scheduled tasks this engine runs as, in one place. A Codex or Cowork session asked to "create the automations" builds them from this file (AGENTS.md, "When Krish says: create the automations"); the README table is the same list for reading. Times are London (Europe/London). Full Time publishes from a 04:45 UTC run, so the morning jobs start after it in both summer and winter time, and the day's pack is ready before 07:30, when fans wake up after a match.
run_in: this local project (not a new worktree), so every run shares local/ (the sync, the packs, the creative record and the lists)
access: network on (github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, fulltime.fm and the channels); the signed-in browser when available
